title: Woman and Projected Image
coreRelationships: The sitting woman's posture and gaze are directed towards the projected image, creating a strong visual link.
The projected image dominates the background, acting as a large, ethereal backdrop to the foreground subject.
The warm, soft lighting unifies both the foreground and background elements, creating a cohesive mood.
The long, flowing hair of both figures creates a sense of movement and softness.
